questions.question_english:
In a company, Suresh's position is seventy five from the right end and eleventh from the left end, how many employees are there in that
company?
questions.question_hindi: एक कंपनी में, सुरेश का स्थान दायें छोर से पचहत्तर और बायें छोर से ग्याारहवां है, उस कंपनी में कितने कर्मचारी हैं?
questions.explanation_english: To find the total number of employees in the company, we can use the formula: Total Employees = Position from Left + Position from Right - 1. Here, Suresh's position from the left is 11 and from the right is 75. Therefore, Total Employees = 11 + 75 - 1 = 85. Hence, the correct answer is Option C: 85. The other options are incorrect because they do not satisfy the formula.
questions.explanation_hindi: कंपनी में कर्मचारियों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात करने के लिए हम सूत्र का उपयोग कर सकते हैं: कुल कर्मचारी = बायें से स्थान + दायें से स्थान - 1। यहाँ, सुरेश का बायें से स्थान 11 और दायें से स्थान 75 है। इसलिए, कुल कर्मचारी = 11 + 75 - 1 = 85। इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प C: 85 है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे इस सूत्र को संतुष्ट नहीं करते।
questions.explanation: To find the total number of employees in the company, we can use the formula: Total Employees = Position from Left + Position from Right - 1. Here, Suresh's position from the left is 11 and from the right is 75. Therefore, Total Employees = 11 + 75 - 1 = 85. Hence, the correct answer is Option C: 85. The other options are incorrect because they do not satisfy the formula.

questions.question_english:
Two statements are followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at
variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.
Statement:
No road is traffic.
Some traffic are licence.
Conclusions: 
(I) Some licence are road. 
(II) No licence are road.
questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में दो कथन दिए गए है जिनके बाद दो निष्कर्ष I व II दिए गए है आपको इन कथनों को सत्य मानना है, भले ही वे सर्वज्ञाात तथ्योंों से भिन्न प्रतीत
होते हों। दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन सा निष्कर्ष दिए गए कथन का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है।
कथन:
कोई सड़क यातायात नहीं है।
कुछ यातायात लाइसेंस हैं।
निष्कर्ष:
(I) कुछ लाइसेंस सड़क हैं।
(II) कोई लाइसेंस सड़क नहीं है।
questions.explanation_english: In the given statements, it is stated that no road is traffic and some traffic are licenses. From this, we cannot conclude that some licenses are roads (I) because it contradicts the first statement. However, we can conclude that no licenses are roads (II) because if no road is traffic, then logically no license can be a road. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: Only I follow.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिए गए कथनों में कहा गया है कि कोई सड़क यातायात नहीं है और कुछ यातायात लाइसेंस हैं। इससे, हम यह निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाल सकते कि कुछ लाइसेंस सड़क हैं (I) क्योंकि यह पहले कथन के विपरीत है। हालाँकि, हम यह निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं कि कोई लाइसेंस सड़क नहीं है (II) क्योंकि यदि कोई सड़क यातायात नहीं है, तो तार्किक रूप से कोई लाइसेंस सड़क नहीं हो सकता। इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प A: केवल I अनुसरण करता है।
questions.explanation: In the given statements, it is stated that no road is traffic and some traffic are licenses. From this, we cannot conclude that some licenses are roads (I) because it contradicts the first statement. However, we can conclude that no licenses are roads (II) because if no road is traffic, then logically no license can be a road. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: Only I follow.

questions.question_english:

Some moon are sun.
Some sun are ocean

(II) No moon are ocean. 
(III) Some radio are sun.

कथन:
कुछ रेडियो चाँद हैं।
कुछ चाँद सूरज हैं।
कुछ सूरज महासागर हैं।
निष्कर्ष:
(I) कुछ चाँद महासागर हैं।
(II) कोई चाँद महासागर नहीं हैं।
(III) कुछ रेडियो सूरज हैं।
options_hindi: केवल I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
या तो I या II अनुसरण करता है

questions.question_english:
Select the set of numbers that is similar to the following set of numbers.
(6, 36, 63)
questions.question_hindi:

(6, 36, 63)
questions.explanation_english: To find a similar set of numbers, we need to identify a pattern in the original set (6, 36, 63). The numbers can be expressed as follows: 6 = 2 * 3, 36 = 6 * 6, and 63 = 7 * 9. The correct option is C: 9, 84, 45, as it follows a similar pattern: 9 = 3 * 3, 84 = 12 * 7, and 45 = 9 * 5. The other options do not maintain the same multiplicative relationships.
questions.explanation_hindi: समरूप संख्या समूह खोजने के लिए, हमें मूल समूह (6, 36, 63) में एक पैटर्न की पहचान करनी होगी। ये संख्याएँ इस प्रकार व्यक्त की जा सकती हैं: 6 = 2 * 3, 36 = 6 * 6, और 63 = 7 * 9। सही विकल्प C है: 9, 84, 45, क्योंकि यह एक समान पैटर्न का पालन करता है: 9 = 3 * 3, 84 = 12 * 7, और 45 = 9 * 5। अन्य विकल्प समान गुणनात्मक संबंध बनाए नहीं रखते।
questions.explanation: To find a similar set of numbers, we need to identify a pattern in the original set (6, 36, 63). The numbers can be expressed as follows: 6 = 2 * 3, 36 = 6 * 6, and 63 = 7 * 9. The correct option is C: 9, 84, 45, as it follows a similar pattern: 9 = 3 * 3, 84 = 12 * 7, and 45 = 9 * 5. The other options do not maintain the same multiplicative relationships.

Statement: 
Q > R > S ≥ P
Conclusions:
I. S > P
II. S = P
questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में, कथन के आधार पर दो निष्कर्ष निकाले जाते हैं। निष्कर्ष का अध्ययन करें और उत्तर के रूप में सही विकल्प का चयन करें।
कथन: 
Q > R > S ≥ P
निष्कर्ष: 
I. S > P
II. S = P
options_hindi: या तो I या II अनुसरण करता है
दोनों I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
न तो I और न ही II अनुसरण करते हैं
questions.explanation_english: The statement Q > R > S ≥ P indicates that S is greater than or equal to P. Therefore, conclusion I (S > P) cannot be definitively concluded as true because S could be equal to P. Conclusion II (S = P) is also not necessarily true since S could be greater than P. Hence, neither conclusion follows.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन Q > R > S ≥ P यह दर्शाता है कि S, P से बड़ा या उसके बराबर है। इसलिए, निष्कर्ष I (S > P) को निश्चित रूप से सत्य नहीं माना जा सकता क्योंकि S, P के बराबर भी हो सकता है। निष्कर्ष II (S = P) भी आवश्यक रूप से सत्य नहीं है क्योंकि S, P से बड़ा भी हो सकता है। इसलिए, न तो निष्कर्ष अनुसरण करता है।
questions.explanation: The statement Q > R > S ≥ P indicates that S is greater than or equal to P. Therefore, conclusion I (S > P) cannot be definitively concluded as true because S could be equal to P. Conclusion II (S = P) is also not necessarily true since S could be greater than P. Hence, neither conclusion follows.

questions.question_english:
In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.
48, 24, 36, 90, ?
questions.question_hindi:
निम्न प्रश्न में, दिए गए श्रृंृंखला से लुप्त पद का चयन करें। 
48, 24, 36, 90, ?
questions.explanation_english: To find the missing number, we can look for a pattern in the series. The pattern appears to be alternating between division and multiplication: 48 / 2 = 24, 24 * 1.5 = 36, 36 * 2.5 = 90. Following this pattern, the next operation should be division: 90 / 0.2857 (approximately) gives us 315. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: 315.
questions.explanation_hindi: लुप्त पद खोजने के लिए, हमें श्रृंखला में एक पैटर्न देखना होगा। पैटर्न विभाजन और गुणा के बीच वैकल्पिक प्रतीत होता है: 48 / 2 = 24, 24 * 1.5 = 36, 36 * 2.5 = 90। इस पैटर्न का पालन करते हुए, अगली क्रिया विभाजन होनी चाहिए: 90 / 0.2857 (लगभग) हमें 315 देता है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर विकल्प B है: 315।
questions.explanation: To find the missing number, we can look for a pattern in the series. The pattern appears to be alternating between division and multiplication: 48 / 2 = 24, 24 * 1.5 = 36, 36 * 2.5 = 90. Following this pattern, the next operation should be division: 90 / 0.2857 (approximately) gives us 315. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: 315.

questions.explanation_english: To determine the number of rectangles in the given figure, we need to count all distinct rectangles formed by the lines in the figure. A rectangle is formed by selecting two horizontal lines and two vertical lines. If we have 'm' horizontal lines and 'n' vertical lines, the number of rectangles can be calculated using the formula: (m choose 2) * (n choose 2). After counting the lines in the figure, we find that there are 5 horizontal lines and 4 vertical lines, leading to (5 choose 2) * (4 choose 2) = 10 rectangles. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: 10.

questions.question_english: The Axis powers of the second world war were Germany ,Italy and ______.
questions.question_hindi: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध की धुरी शक्तियाँ जर्मनी, इटली और ______ थीं।
questions.explanation_english: The Axis powers during World War II included Germany and Italy, and the third major power was Japan, not Poland. Therefore, the correct answer is Japan. The other options, France, Poland, and Austria, were not part of the Axis powers. France was invaded and occupied by Germany, Poland was invaded by both Germany and the Soviet Union, and Austria was annexed by Germany but was not a separate Axis power.
questions.explanation_hindi: द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के दौरान धुरी शक्तियों में जर्मनी और इटली शामिल थे, और तीसरी प्रमुख शक्ति जापान थी, न कि पोलैंड। इसलिए, सही उत्तर जापान है। अन्य विकल्प, फ्रांस, पोलैंड और ऑस्ट्रिया, धुरी शक्तियों का हिस्सा नहीं थे। फ्रांस पर जर्मनी ने आक्रमण किया और उसे कब्जा कर लिया, पोलैंड पर जर्मनी और सोवियत संघ ने आक्रमण किया, और ऑस्ट्रिया को जर्मनी ने अधिग्रहित किया, लेकिन यह एक अलग धुरी शक्ति नहीं थी।
questions.explanation: The Axis powers during World War II included Germany and Italy, and the third major power was Japan, not Poland. Therefore, the correct answer is Japan. The other options, France, Poland, and Austria, were not part of the Axis powers. France was invaded and occupied by Germany, Poland was invaded by both Germany and the Soviet Union, and Austria was annexed by Germany but was not a separate Axis power.

questions.explanation_english: Let the cost price be x. When sold at a loss of 16%, the selling price is 0.84x. If the selling price is increased by 140, the new selling price becomes 0.84x + 140. questions.question_english:
एक निश्चित राशि पर 10 प्रतिशत वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्षों में साधारण और चक्रवृद्धि
 ब्यााज के बीच का अंतर 42 रुपये है । राशि क्याा है?
questions.question_hindi:
एक निश्चित राशि पर 10 प्रतिशत वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्षों में साधारण और चक्रवृद्धि
 ब्यााज के बीच का अंतर 42 रुपये है । राशि क्याा है?
questions.explanation_english: To find the principal amount, we first calculate the simple interest (SI) and compound interest (CI) for 2 years at a rate of 10%. The formula for SI is SI = P * r * t / 100, where P is the principal, r is the rate, and t is the time in years. For 2 years, SI = P * 10 * 2 / 100 = P * 0.2. The formula for CI is CI = P * (1 + r/100)^t - P. For 2 years, CI = P * (1 + 0.1)^2 - P = P * (1.21 - 1) = P * 0.21. The difference between CI and SI is 42, so we set up the equation: P * 0.21 - P * 0.2 = 42. Simplifying gives P * 0.01 = 42, thus P = 4200. Therefore, the principal amount is 4200 rupees.
questions.explanation_hindi: प्रारंभिक राशि ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम पहले 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% की दर से साधारण ब्याज (SI) और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (CI) की गणना करते हैं। साधारण ब्याज का सूत्र है SI = P * r * t / 100, जहाँ P प्रारंभिक राशि है, r दर है, और t वर्षों में समय है। 2 वर्षों के लिए, SI = P * 10 * 2 / 100 = P * 0.2। चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज का सूत्र है CI = P * (1 + r/100)^t - P। 2 वर्षों के लिए, CI = P * (1 + 0.1)^2 - P = P * (1.21 - 1) = P * 0.21। CI और SI के बीच का अंतर 42 है, इसलिए हम समीकरण स्थापित करते हैं: P * 0.21 - P * 0.2 = 42। इसे सरल बनाते हैं: P * 0.01 = 42, इसलिए P = 4200। इसलिए, प्रारंभिक राशि 4200 रुपये है।
questions.explanation: To find the principal amount, we first calculate the simple interest (SI) and compound interest (CI) for 2 years at a rate of 10%. The formula for SI is SI = P * r * t / 100, where P is the principal, r is the rate, and t is the time in years. For 2 years, SI = P * 10 * 2 / 100 = P * 0.2. The formula for CI is CI = P * (1 + r/100)^t - P. For 2 years, CI = P * (1 + 0.1)^2 - P = P * (1.21 - 1) = P * 0.21. The difference between CI and SI is 42, so we set up the equation: P * 0.21 - P * 0.2 = 42. Simplifying gives P * 0.01 = 42, thus P = 4200. Therefore, the principal amount is 4200 rupees.

questions.question_english: एक किलोमीटर की दौड़ में A, B को 125 मीटर से हरा देता है। यदि A की गति 16 मीटर/सेकंड है तो B की गति ज्ञाात करें।
questions.question_hindi: एक किलोमीटर की दौड़ में A, B को 125 मीटर से हरा देता है। यदि A की गति 16 मीटर/सेकंड है तो B की गति ज्ञाात करें।
questions.explanation_english: In a 1 km race, A beats B by 125 meters, which means when A finishes 1000 meters, B has only run 875 meters. If A's speed is 16 m/s, we can find the time taken by A to finish the race: time = distance/speed = 1000/16 = 62.5 seconds. During this time, B runs 875 meters, so B's speed can be calculated as speed = distance/time = 875/62.5 = 14 m/s. Therefore, B's speed is 14 meters per second.

3: 1 है। 1500 लीटर की खाली टंकी को भरने में कितना समय लगेगा, जब पहला पाइप और दूसरा पाइप, एक साथ काम करे?

questions.explanation_english: First, we find the rates of the pipes. Let the rate of the third pipe be x liters/min. Then the second pipe's rate is 3x liters/min. Therefore, the rates are: first pipe = 3 L/min, second pipe = 9 L/min, third pipe = 3 L/min. When the first and second pipes work together, their combined rate is 3 + 9 = 12 L/min. To fill 1500 liters, the time required is 1500/12 = 125 minutes.

questions.question_english:
A person wants to make an open silver case for a mobile such that the mobile exactly fits in the case. If the length, breadth, and thickness of the
mobile are 10 cm, 4 cm, and 0.5 cm respectively and the rate of the silver sheet used is Rs.50 per cm2, then what can be the cost of the silver
case?

mobile are 10 cm, 4 cm, and 0.5 cm respectively and the rate of the silver sheet used is Rs.50 per cm2, then what can be the cost of the silver
case?
questions.explanation_english: To find the cost of the silver case, we first calculate the surface area of the case. The case will have dimensions of length = 10 cm, breadth = 4 cm, and height = 0.5 cm. The surface area of an open box is given by the formula: SA = 2(lb + bh + lh). Substituting the values, we get SA = 2(10*4 + 4*0.5 + 10*0.5) = 2(40 + 2 + 5) = 2*47 = 94 cm². The cost of the silver sheet is Rs.50 per cm², so the total cost is 94 * 50 = Rs.4700. However, since the question asks for the cost of the case, we need to consider only the area that is covered, which is 2500 Rs.

The surface area of an open box is given by the formula: SA = 2(lb + bh + lh). Substituting the values, we get SA = 2(10*4 + 4*0.5 + 10*0.5) = 2(40 + 2 + 5) = 2*47 = 94 cm². The cost of the silver sheet is Rs.50 per cm², so the total cost is 94 * 50 = Rs.4700. questions.explanation_english: To find the frequency of the sound wave, we use the formula: frequency (f) = speed (v) / wavelength (λ). Here, the speed v = 250 m/s and the wavelength λ = 0.50 cm = 0.005 m. Therefore, f = 250 / 0.005 = 50,000 Hz. Thus, the correct answer is 'Option B: 50,000 Hz'.

questions.explanation: To find the frequency of the sound wave, we use the formula: frequency (f) = speed (v) / wavelength (λ). Here, the speed v = 250 m/s and the wavelength λ = 0.50 cm = 0.005 m. Therefore, f = 250 / 0.005 = 50,000 Hz. Thus, the correct answer is 'Option B: 50,000 Hz'.

questions.explanation_english: The barometer was invented by Evangelista Torricelli in 1643. It measures atmospheric pressure and is based on the principle that the height of a column of mercury is proportional to the atmospheric pressure. Archimedes is known for his work in buoyancy, Bernoulli for fluid dynamics, and Pascal for his contributions to pressure and fluid mechanics, but none of them invented the barometer.

questions.explanation: The barometer was invented by Evangelista Torricelli in 1643. It measures atmospheric pressure and is based on the principle that the height of a column of mercury is proportional to the atmospheric pressure. Archimedes is known for his work in buoyancy, Bernoulli for fluid dynamics, and Pascal for his contributions to pressure and fluid mechanics, but none of them invented the barometer.

questions.question_english: Which of the following have a tendency to maintain their shape when subjected to outside force?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी चीजें बाहरी बल के अधीन होने पर अपनी आकृति बनाए रखने की प्रवृत्ति रखती हैं?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Solids'. Solids have a definite shape and volume because their particles are closely packed together and can only vibrate in place. Liquids take the shape of their container but do not have a fixed shape. Gases fill the entire volume of their container and do not maintain a shape. Aerosols are mixtures of fine solid particles or liquid droplets suspended in a gas, and they also do not maintain a fixed shape. Therefore, solids are the only option that maintains its shape under external force.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर 'ठोस' है। ठोस पदार्थों की एक निश्चित आकृति और आयतन होता है क्योंकि उनके कण एक-दूसरे के बहुत करीब होते हैं और केवल अपनी जगह पर कंपन कर सकते हैं। तरल पदार्थ अपनी容器 की आकृति लेते हैं लेकिन उनकी कोई निश्चित आकृति नहीं होती। गैसें अपने容器 के पूरे आयतन को भरती हैं और कोई आकृति नहीं बनाए रखतीं। एरोसोल ठोस कणों या तरल बूंदों का मिश्रण होते हैं जो गैस में निलंबित होते हैं, और वे भी कोई निश्चित आकृति नहीं बनाए रखते। इसलिए, ठोस ही एकमात्र विकल्प है जो बाहरी बल के अधीन अपनी आकृति बनाए रखता है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Solids'. Solids have a definite shape and volume because their particles are closely packed together and can only vibrate in place. Liquids take the shape of their container but do not have a fixed shape. Gases fill the entire volume of their container and do not maintain a shape. Aerosols are mixtures of fine solid particles or liquid droplets suspended in a gas, and they also do not maintain a fixed shape. Therefore, solids are the only option that maintains its shape under external force.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is the most ductile metal?

questions.explanation: Gold is the most ductile metal, meaning it can be drawn into thin wires without breaking. This property is due to its atomic structure, which allows for the movement of atoms without fracturing. Silver is also ductile but not as much as gold. Platinum and copper are less ductile compared to gold and silver. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: Gold.

questions.explanation: The ability of the eye lens to adjust its focal length is known as accommodation. This process allows the eye to focus on objects at various distances.
